messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Severity: high — spike in 429s for tenant=valedor (VPC us-west-2). Detected at 2421009876. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/alerts/2421009876 :rotating_light:

lena-oncall: picking this up. seeing a sharp 429 increase from valedor starting ~5m ago. will triage. @marcus-eng can you pull request traces?

marcus-eng: looking now. logs show repeated rate_limit_exceeded at the VPC ingress layer. sample log: ```
{"ts":"...","tenant":"valedor","error":"rate_limit_exceeded","route":"/v1/generate","req_id":"r-9a7f"}
{"ts":"...","tenant":"valedor","error":"rate_limit_exceeded","req_id":"r-9b0c"}
```
queue/backpressure metrics: dedicated-pool-valedor util=92%, inflight-requests=48, avg-latency=320ms.

priya-csm: Valedor is on the phone, live checkout failures in production. They report intermittent 429s across multiple services. They asked for an emergency throughput lift while you investigate — will need a contract note but want immediate mitigation.

emily-support: shared screenshots from customer showing 429 responses and id tokens failing. they said outage started ~10:12 PST. i'll keep them updated.

jake-runtime: quick options: 1) route valedor to overflow-reserved pool (if capacity exists) 2) temporarily bump tenant_rate_limit for valedor in admin API 3) enable lightweight prefix caching to reduce tokens. pref: 1 + 2 for redundancy.

sofia-sre: caution — bumping an aggressive rate could impact co-tenants if we put them on shared capacity. need to verify isolation on overflow pool. prefer routing to a dedicated hot spare if available.

lena-oncall: checking spare pools... spare-dedicated-2 has ~40% headroom. i'm going to 1) route a small % (10%) to spare pool as a canary, 2) open emergency rate override for valedor +20% for all routes, capped until 23:59 UTC. posting admin commands below.

lena-oncall: admin API call (internal, auth required):
```
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.internal/tenants/valedor/rate_limit/override" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"increase_pct":20, "expires_at":"2026-03-15T23:59:00Z", "reason":"emergency customer impact - valedor checkout errors"}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy accepted. change-id: ch-55321. routing rule applied: valedor -> 10% spare-dedicated-2. override flag set (expires 2026-03-15T23:59:00Z). :white_check_mark:

marcus-eng: after routing + override: 429 rate for valedor dropped from 1800/min to ~120/min within 2m. still seeing bursts on heavy batched requests. hooking perf trace to see KV cache miss rate.

jake-runtime: if KV cache miss is high we should enable prefix caching for valedor's common prompts. quick toggle below: 
```
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.internal/tenants/valedor/cache_config" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prefix_cache_enabled":true, "prefix_ttl_sec":300}'
```

emily-support: sending status update to Valedor: "We've applied temporary routing and a rate override to reduce 429s. Our engineers are monitoring and will follow up when we have a permanent remediation. Temporary measures expire at 23:59 UTC."

priya-csm: I'll handle the contract exception paperwork. need approval from legal/finance for a formal credit/override but we can log this as an emergency exception. creating a ticket REF-VAL-842.

sofia-sre: notes for next steps: 1) run tenant isolation audit on spare-dedicated-2 2) run post-mortem analyzing why valedor spiked (client-side pattern or backend retry storm) 3) consider per-route leaky-bucket to avoid sudden spikes impacting pool.

lena-oncall: handing off to @sofia-sre for overnight watch. summary: applied 10% routing to spare pool, +20% emergency override (expires 23:59 UTC), KV prefix caching enabled. current status: 429s reduced but not fully resolved — monitoring 15m. customer notified. logs/graph links: https://dash.redwood/tenant/valedor/overview

sofia-sre: ack, taking over. will keep monitor and escalate if 429s climb above 300/min sustained. lena, please DM me any artifacts. i'll patch runbook and open postmortem stub.

lena-oncall: leaving notes in incident doc: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/valedor-2421009876. thanks team. :coffee:

marcus-eng: quick debug note — observed many small requests with tight client-side retry loops causing request bursts. recommend CS ask valedor to implement jittered backoff asap. will capture example traces for postmortem.

priya-csm: I'll coordinate with Valedor PM to change client retry behaviour and confirm workplan. ETA for customer-side change: 48h.

emily-support: closing the customer-facing blurb now; will update if anything changes.

deploy-bot: monitoring alert cleared for incident 2421009876 — 429 rate returned to baseline for valedor.

sofia-sre: final handoff checklist added to incident doc. leaving on-call watch with follow-ups: postmortem + contract exception ticket. closing thread in 2h if stable.

emily-support: marking this as customer-impacting (P2).
